tools.name: compute_vaults
tools.description:
On-chain figures for the USD.AI and GAIB compute vaults.

Call this for tokens outstanding, vault share price, and the trailing 90-day figure. trailing_90d_apy_percent annualizes the change in vault share price over the trailing window. It is not an issuer-quoted yield. loan_count and loan_balance_u

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description:
One published asset, with per-chain supply and an optional daily price history.

Call this after list_assets, or when the id is already known. Pass the id from an ambiguous result. Do not guess among assets that share a display ticker.

JSON is the asset card plus by_chain (chain, supply, market_cap

tools.name: gpu_price_index
tools.description:
Latest GPU rental price index, in US dollars per GPU-hour.

Call this for the current median rental price of a GPU model, or for prices by GPU memory. Omit model for every published model plus the 16, 64, 256, and 512 GB tiers. Pass one model name for that model only.

On-demand is list price. Spot

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description:
List published tokenized assets.

Call this to find an asset by ticker, name, category, chain, or issuer before get_asset. Live assets are the galactic.inc screener universe. Announced listings have a launch date and no supply, price, or holders.

JSON shape: {"matched", "offset", "limit", "assets":

tools.name: market_totals
tools.description:
Category and chain totals for the published asset universe.

Call this for asset counts, pricing coverage, and holder totals. The aggregate market cap is published only when every listed asset has a published on-chain price. Until then market_cap_usd is null, market_cap_withheld is true, every by_ca

tools.name: search_news
tools.description:
Search approved galactic.inc newsroom items.

Call this for recent headlines about an asset, an issuer, or a topic. Items that are not approved are omitted. The response has no source URL.

JSON: {"matched", "items": [{id, date, category, headline, lede, assets}]}. assets is a list of tickers. date

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_news · Private data: compute_vaults, get_asset, list_assets · Public sink: compute_vaults, get_asset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_news · Private data: compute_vaults, get_asset, list_assets · Public sink: compute_vaults, get_asset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
